records.name: Sokrates Nochnefrage
records.biography_en: Asks one harmless question and politely waits for the building to reconsider. His bell interrupts HyperNorm certainty with one more question. A dissonant card asks whether not knowing can be the beginning of good company. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rückfrage ist klein. Ihr Aufenthaltsbedarf wächst.

variant_notes.note_en: Asks one harmless question and politely waits for the building to reconsider.

records.name: Nietzsch Nocheinmal
records.biography_en: Has overcome everything except the need to announce it. His HyperNorm sun brooch announces a triumph over inherited rules. A dissonant card asks why everybody must applaud in the prescribed way. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Überwindung erfordert weiterhin eine kurze Würdigung.

variant_notes.note_en: Has overcome everything except the need to announce it.

records.name: Madame Vielleicht
records.biography_en: Finds the reflection convincing enough to demand another opinion. Her mirror tests whether HyperNorm certainty survives being looked at twice. A dissonant card offers another angle without claiming it is the final one. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Zweifel wurde durch Gegenprüfung zunächst bestätigt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the reflection convincing enough to demand another opinion.

records.name: Diogenes Weniggenug
records.biography_en: Owns almost nothing and has strong views about the maintenance bill. His little HyperNorm barrel contains enough space for nearly all his needs. A dissonant card needs shelter and complicates his theory of enough. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der geringe Besitz weist einen bemerkenswerten Verwaltungsaufwand auf.

variant_notes.note_en: Owns almost nothing and has strong views about the maintenance bill.

records.name: Kant Punktgenau
records.biography_en: Would prefer the unforeseen to submit its timetable in advance. His clock admits HyperNorm surprises only at scheduled intervals. A dissonant card arrives early and politely asks who owns the minute. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Unvorhergesehene hat den Termin nicht eingehalten.

variant_notes.note_en: Would prefer the unforeseen to submit its timetable in advance.

records.name: Schröda Ungeöffnet
records.biography_en: Keeps her options open by keeping the lid almost closed. Her HyperNorm box remains classified until its lid has supplied an answer. A dissonant card asks whether uncertainty requires a prisoner inside. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Möglichkeiten wurden vorsorglich noch nicht geöffnet.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps her options open by keeping the lid almost closed.
